pages.title: Dawn Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r First complete the advancement 'Though We Fall, We Remain'. Then, holding a weapon enchanted with Dawn, slay another Wither between sunset and sunrise (the whole night). The Dawn Star falls into your inventory on its own, and the advancement 'So-Called Dawn, At Last Set Free' lights up.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held or embedded in armor (embedding into armor does not weaken it): killing hostile mobs builds 'Morning Light' — +0.25 charge per kill, or +2 if your main-hand weapon is enchanted with Dawn, up to 10. When Morning Light reaches 10, 'Dawn' triggers automatically.

pages.title: Dawn Resonance
pages.text: §l'Dawn' State: §r Lasts 180 seconds. During it, Morning Light stays at 10 and cannot build any further; only when the state ends is all Morning Light cleared, followed by a 90-second cooldown — Morning Light can be built again only after the cooldown ends. During it: damage ×1.25, critical chance +10%, movement speed +10%, and 2.5 HP restored every 2 seconds.$(br2)At the moment of trigger, a golden pillar of light rises from your feet to the sound of a beacon activating — the same lineage as Dawn's 'Pierce the Night'.$(br2)§7Core loop: Dawn builds, the star bursts.
